newsitem.title: USA: Listing Services names former NYNEX executive CEO.
newsitem.headline: Listing Services names former NYNEX executive CEO.

text.p: Listing Services Solutions said on Tuesday it named Walter Rickard, a former NYNEX Corp executive, as company president and chief executive officer effective October 1.
Rickard was president and CEO of the NYNEX Entertainment and Information Service Group since 1994, the company said in a statement.

He would lead Listing Services' efforts to develop and market a national directory assistance database for telecommunications companies, expected to be launched in the fourth quarter 1996, the company said.
Listing Services was formed by executives from International Business Machines Corp and the regional bell operating companies about 18 months ago and Rickard would be the first president and CEO.
San-Francisco based investment bank Hambrecht & Quist Inc was a "significant owner" in the company, said Gene Eidenberg, advisory director at Hambrecht & Quist.

"We have a great deal of confidence in the company's future," he said. Listing Services plans to provide a full range of telecommunications services, including automatic call completion, in conjunction with operator services companies.
